process.label: Process
process.title: How we work
process.lead: Clear steps from your first message to handover.

steps.title: Enquiry
steps.text: Describe the job in the form or by email. We clarify the details and arrange a site visit.

steps.title: Site visit
steps.text: We assess the site or room: ground conditions, levels, machine access and the scope of work.

steps.title: Estimate & plan
steps.text: We agree materials, stages and timing, and set out the price in an estimate.

steps.title: Works
steps.text: We work to the agreed plan and keep you updated at every stage.

steps.title: Handover & clean-up
steps.text: We hand over the finished work, clean the site and remove construction waste.

about.label: About
about.title: About the company
text: RUHOR Company s.r.o. is a construction company registered in Prague. We lay paving, carry out groundworks and concrete works, build terraces, carports and turnkey houses, and renovate interiors.
Our portfolio includes granite squares, industrial yards, car parks, retail spaces and private yards. Every photo on this website comes from our own sites.

p: The data controller is {company}, IČO {ico}, {address}. For any data-related questions, contact us at {email}.

Only what you tell us yourself: during a call, in a WhatsApp message or in an email — your name, phone number or email address and the content of your message. The website itself collects no data and has no forms.
To answer your enquiry, clarify the details and prepare an offer. The legal basis is taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

We keep enquiry data for up to 12 months after our last contact if no contract is concluded. If a contract is concluded, we keep it for as long as the law requires for contractual and accounting records.

The website is hosted by Vercel Inc. We handle correspondence through a Seznam.cz mailbox and, if you choose that route, through WhatsApp (Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd.). These providers process data only to deliver their services. Some of them may process data outside the EU under the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.
We do not sell your data or share it for advertising.

This website uses no cookies, no analytics and no advertising trackers. Fonts and images are served from our own server. The hosting provider may temporarily keep technical logs (such as IP addresses) for security and reliable operation.
You have the right to access, correct or delete your data, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object to processing. Write to us at {email}.
You may also lodge a complaint with the Czech supervisory authority, Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů (www.uoou.cz).
